case_title: VOELLER, HAROLD - LUCILLE INCLINE PROPERTY VS MCELHERNE, PAUL JR.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,475.00 FILED BY VOELLER, HAROLD - LUCILLE INCLINE PROPERTY AS TO DEFENDANT MCELHERNE, PAUL JR. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-31-2007 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF --(POS FEE $75.00)-- SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT MCELHERNE, PAUL JR.
LETTER REQUEST TO CHANGE VENUE WAS RECEIVED FROM DEFT. ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF RECEIPT (CHALLENGE OF VENUE) SENT TO ALL PARTIES.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-31-2007 - JUDGMENT. WILBER/RAYRAY-CLERKS, JPT DANIEL DEAN, NOTHING ON RECORD.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF VOELLER, HAROLD - LUCILLE INCLINE PROPERTY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MCELHERNE, PAUL JR. $3,125.00 PRINCIPAL, $125.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,250.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS RETURNED TO PLAINTIFF VOELLER, HAROLD - LUCILLE INCLINE PROPERTY
MOTION TO VACATE JUDGMENT FILED BY DEFENDANT MCELHERNE, PAUL JR. HEARING SET FOR JAN-16-2008 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
COPY OF NOTICE OF MOTION TO VACATE MAILED TO ALL PARTIES.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-16-2008 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-16-2008 BY PAUL SLAVIT. ALL PARTIES PRESENT. PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RETAINED. DEFENDANT TO SUBMIT ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE TO THE COURT BY JANUARY 18, 2008. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).

MOTION TO VACATE JUDGMENT FILED BY MCELHERNE, PAUL JR. IS GRANTED. DEFENDANT MADE TIMELY REQUEST FOR CHANGE OF VENUE, WHICH COURT DID NOT DECIDE BEFORE ENTRY OF JUDGMENT. CHALLENGE TO VENUE GRANTED. CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE, TO BE FILED IN PROPER COUNTY. COMMISSIONER PAUL SLAVIT. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAY 18, 2010 ORDERED DESTROYED.
